title: Peer block fetch via XCID protocol
description:
Implement the XCID extension so transit peers can fetch missing blocks on demand after gossip reconciliation.

Why this issue exists:
When gossip delivers a group log entry whose article block is not locally present, the transit daemon has no mechanism to retrieve it. XCID adds a bespoke NNTP extension command that serves raw IPFS blocks peer-to-peer.

What needs to be done:
- XCID command spec and transit CAPABILITIES advertisement
- XCID responder: serve blocks on demand
- Fetch task with want queue and dedup
- Wire fetch task into gossip reconciliation to fill gaps
- Two-node integration test
notes: Review converged after 2 rounds. P0 fix: backfill closure was ignoring LogEntryId parameter (would have broken multi-entry DAG traversal). P1 fix: error message now includes peer address.
